reusePage.name: Reusable Page Template
reusePage.description: This is a customizable page template that can be adapted for different departments, programs, or institutional sections.
reusePage.vision: To provide a flexible and customizable template that can be easily adapted for various institutional needs while maintaining consistency in design and user experience.
reusePage.mission: To streamline content management and ensure uniform presentation across different sections of the institution while allowing for specific customization based on requirements.
